biotools.summary: Flexynesis is a deep learning framework designed for integrating multi-omics data, focusing on usability and adaptability for applications like precision oncology. It streamlines data processing and enables rigorous model evaluation with features like unsupervised feature selection and compatibility with various data types and modeling approaches.
